answer: Like a deep orchard rooted across fungal mycelium, an agent network anchors consensus in recursive, stake-weighted trust paths. Every peer branches out like a hardy juniper, verifying reciprocal commitments; a predatory falcon swooping in cannot fake synthetic lineages. Sybil expansion demands dense multi-hop endorsement bonds, imposing superlinear attacker cost that drains malicious capital before artificial swarms can dilute consensus.
